messages:
alicia: Heads-up — noticed a spike of pod restarts in prod-gpu-us-west1. ~15% of inference replicas restarted over the last 20m. Nodes in nodepool gpu-spot-usw1-a show network egress errors and then flip NotReady, which triggers drains and leaves the autoscaler scrambling to replace them.

mohit: Yea I saw that metric jump. Cloud egress bytes/sec for gpu-spot-usw1-a shot up at 03:20 UTC. Could be NAT gateway throttling or provider-side egress caps for preemptible VMs. No obvious CPU/memory pressure on the nodes before network errors.

ben: Any logs from kubelet/CNI? Also curious if kube-proxy conntrack is filling up during the rebalances.

zara: Deploy bot shows a bunch of scale events failing to schedule: "Insufficient resources: gpu" while autoscaler reported nodes provisioning but not becoming Ready.

sre-bot: Cluster-autoscaler: scale-up attempt detected for gpu-spot-usw1-a but node group quota limit reached -> instance creation delayed.

alicia: Proposed immediate mitigation: 1) provision a small on-demand burst nodepool (gpu-burst-usw1, min=3) in the same AZ with higher egress quota; 2) taint it (gpu=reserved:NoSchedule) and update critical inference deployments with tolerations/affinity so they prefer it; 3) add a fallback route to alternate NAT (higher quota) for the cluster; 4) avoid mass rolling restarts while rebalancing.

mohit: I can spin up the on-demand nodepool. Will use a2-highgpu-1 and pick the same image + containerd settings. Command I plan to run:

```
# create burst nodepool
gcloud container node-pools create gpu-burst-usw1 \
  --cluster=prod-gpu-us-west1 \
  --machine-type=a2-highgpu-1 \
  --num-nodes=3 \
  --min-nodes=3 \
  --max-nodes=6 \
  --node-taints=gpu=reserved:NoSchedule \
  --node-labels=pool=burst
```

mohit: Also will open a ticket with cloud to confirm NAT egress caps and request temporary quota bump.

ben: Meanwhile I will update the cluster-autoscaler configmap to bias critical namespaces to on-demand fallback. We'll add an annotation to the ml-inference namespace and a custom balancing policy so critical pods get preferred scheduling on gpu-burst-usw1. I’ll also increase the autoscaler max-per-nodegroup for the burst pool.

zara: I’ll patch Deployment strategies for ml-inference to use maxUnavailable: 1 and increase readinessProbe/gracePeriod to avoid premature restarts during node churn. Also will add nodeAffinity for pool=burst as a soft preference for high-priority replicas.

alicia: Quick checklist: Mohit create nodepool + attach route; Ben patch autoscaler config; Zara patch deployments; I'll monitor pods/evictions and the k8s events. ETA ~30m for burst nodes to become Ready. Post updates here.

mohit: Starting now. Creating nodepool and applying taints/labels.

mohit: Update — gpu-burst-usw1 ready (3 nodes). I applied the taint and labels, and added a temporary route to nat-backup-usw1 with higher egress quota. Also added nodepool to cluster-autoscaler config.

ben: I pushed the autoscaler changes and added an annotation to ml-inference namespace: autoscaler.k8s.io/preferredPool=gpu-burst-usw1. Also raised max nodes for burst group to 6.

zara: I patched deployments (maxUnavailable=1) and added soft nodeAffinity for pool=burst. Rolling updates set to slow > 2m between pods.

mohit: Observed pods scheduling onto burst pool — roughly 60% of the previously-failing replicas moved over. Pod restarts dropped significantly. Network egress metrics for gpu-spot-usw1-a are trending down as we drain hot nodes.

alicia: Nice. Leaving spot nodes cordoned and draining slowly. We'll keep burst pool as temporary reserve until cloud confirms NAT quota bump.

ben: Follow-ups: (1) Create a runbook entry for 'egress-throttle -> activate burst pool', (2) add alert to surface probe of node egress errors earlier, (3) evaluate connection pooling / CNI settings to reduce per-node egress.

mohit: Filing the NAT quota ticket and will follow up with the account team.

alicia: Thanks everyone. If the egress caps reappear we'll failover traffic to eu-west1 reserved pool and reopen this thread with rollback steps. Keeping this thread open for monitoring.
